title: Marina R Probable NDE 6702
content: I recall conscious awareness from when I was in utero. However, I am not sure of the chronological order of these events. I remember the contractions all around me. I was 'seeing' in the darkness. I could feel my mother’s fear. I was feeling overcome by drugged sleep, and sliding and losing control going down a slippery slope. I guess that is both literal and metaphorical. I felt a sheer veil of panic. It felt like everything was moving very fast but slow at the same time. I was very aware that there wasn’t anybody there to receive me. They didn’t even see me or know I was there! I have always had this feeling I am not seen, or that they think I'm invisible. I feel/see the room along with the doctor and two nurses. At the same time, I saw my dad in joy about me. But I am in a bell jar with the feeling of being disconnected between us. Like a museum piece. The lights were very bright. I was stuck on my back and couldn't move. I was very cold. I also saw my 'spiritual family' of about six people. There was a 'mom and dad,' two siblings, and a little blonde one year old girl in a dress in front of the mom. Mom had her hands on the little girl's shoulders. The father and son of seven or eight were the same way. Next to them to the right were two more adults. There is a sense of many more behind them, like a whole crowd, but I didn’t see them. I wanted to be with them but they conveyed that they couldn't come. They had to stay, but they are always with me. I had to go as I moved away from them. I am consciousness, but not yet with a body .I hear the siren of the ambulance. It is loud. I am bounced around. Panic is around me but it isn’t what I feel. I am just present. Next I recall being under bright lights. It hurts. There are tubes in me. I feel pinned. I am above the incubator. I can see this little scrawny wrinkled red baby full of tubes and tape. I am back in the box though I can’t see it. I can feel the confinement, the inside corners of the glass box. There is a big (male) head close, with a distorted face, staring at me. All they do is come and stare at me and go away again.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Reports being above the incubator and seeing the baby in the incubator.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Describes panic/veil of panic during birth; later says panic was around her but she felt 'just present'.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Describes 'sliding and losing control going down a slippery slope' (literal/metaphorical).
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Everything moving 'very fast but slow at the same time'.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw a 'spiritual family' of about six people (mom/dad, siblings, a little blonde one-year-old girl, plus two more adults; sensed many more behind them). Also later saw a big male head with distorted face staring.

environment.environment_other_detail: Bright hospital/delivery/incubator setting; describes confinement inside a glass 'box'/'bell jar' with corners.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Describes being 'back in the box' and feeling confinement; no clear mechanism described.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Perinatal/birth-related events with ambulance, incubator, tubes; reports awareness from in utero through birth and neonatal care.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prenatal/birth awareness; 'spiritual family'; ambulance siren; incubator observation; confinement in glass 'box/bell jar'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Narrative spans in utero awareness, birth/delivery room perceptions, 'spiritual family' presence, ambulance transport, then viewing the baby from above the incubator and returning to confinement.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports perceiving the room with doctor/nurses while also seeing her dad in joy; also describes being in a 'bell jar' while perceiving others.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perinatal (in utero/birth) consciousness with hospital/ambulance/incubator imagery; repeated 'bell jar/glass box' confinement; 'spiritual family' present but unable to come; sense of being unseen/invisible.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I am consciousness, but not yet with a body.”; “I was very aware that there wasn’t anybody there to receive me.”; “I am above the incubator. I can see this little scrawny wrinkled red baby full of tubes and tape.”
